narrative:
## Handover Summary — Claims & Cost of Care

Cost of care is set at GBP 2.80B (73.6% of revenue), 1.1 points better than FY2026.

## Key Decisions
- Corporate PMI network steerage target raised to 40% of eligible claims by FY2028
- Care-home agency reduction built into the cost base
- Mental health digital pathway rolled out in the North first

## Recommendations for Workforce & Clinical Staffing
- Convert agency savings into permanent bank-staff headcount
- Size dental hiring to the private membership growth from Step 1

## Risk Factors
- Oncology drug cost inflation above the modelled range
- Provider tariff negotiations still open with two hospital groups
